body.t: Select a US coordinate to query Census school-district geography. The result reports the available district fields for that point and source vintage. It is a geography lookup, not a promise of enrollment eligibility, school assignment or admission. Record the input and mode with any exported or reported result.

For a point close to a district boundary, first inspect the map pin and record its coordinates. Compare the returned district identifier with the local district office before making an enrollment decision; a county name alone is not enough.
